frontmatter.name: crawl-repo-to-llms
frontmatter.description: Compile a repository dossier by static reading: file cards, purpose, safe-edit evidence, indexes, infrastructure, history and executable options. TRIGGER: "repo dossier", "per-file breakdown", "onboard an agent to this repo", "inventory every command and flag", "/crawl- repo2llms". SKIP: commands/docs condensation only → crawl-to-llms-txt; one concept → llms- concept-abstractor; notes → notes-to-llms-txt; one document or SKILL.md conversion → llms-txt- tooling; web research → full-suite; edit repo meta-docs → repo-bootstrapper; code fixes → code-deep-optimizer; existing-family quality → llms-deep-optimizer. Full handoffs are in Routing detail.
whenToUse: compile this repo into one context pack an agent can load before touching it
give me a per-file breakdown: what each file does and when I'd open it
which files matter here, and what breaks if I edit them
document the indexes in this repo — kind, embedding model, how to query
map the infra: CI, launchd jobs, env vars, external services
refresh the repo dossier, only what changed since the last commit I indexed
how do I start the server / kick off the main process / run this thing
list every CLI flag, config field, and env var this repo reads
